is: open-core publication funnel + governance validator (Rust)
is: PUBLIC CANDIDATE contracts, synthetic fixtures, deterministic CLI
is-not: scoring engine, fusion, user model, raw telemetry, clinical product
is-not: production API, SDK seat offer, medical device, diagnosis

- README.md

- cargo test --workspace --locked
- cargo run -p governance-cli -- validate records/
- ingest() returns RAW_STREAM_REFUSED on raw streams
- hash(record) independent of ambient clock
